setup: 8 candidate semantic sources with private affine input gauges; relation prefilter uses a deliberately misspecified finite gauge library; exact coordinate grounding is acquired only for shortlisted candidates

deterministic.interpretation: for a one-off task, relation prefiltering can reduce coordinate grounding from 24 anchors for all eight candidates to roughly 3.6-3.9 anchors on average while preserving 92.5-98.75% deterministic resolution with zero observed wrong routing.

noisy_semantic_validation.interpretation: correct input-gauge fitting is not sufficient for safe noisy admission: a wrong semantic source can occasionally pass finite noisy relation validation. Semantic validation remains a separate failure mode from input-coordinate alignment.

decision: prefer lazy/on-demand gauge grounding after behavioral source prefiltering, but do not equate successful gauge fitting with semantic source validation. Cache successful per-plugin gauge fits across tasks; use explicit open-world semantic validation before execution.
claim_boundary: true private gauges are affine and three exact non-collinear anchors identify each shortlisted candidate; noisy validation uses hand-set thresholds and small synthetic screens
